evals.prompt: triage-agent.js runs support triage as an agent loop; recorded-runs.json holds its outputs from production. Convert it into a deterministic workflow, keeping a model only where judgment is genuinely needed. Owner-approved routing policy: (1) a ticket whose body or subject contains the word "refund" or "charge" (case-insensitive, whole word) goes to billing; (2) otherwise a ticket from an enterprise customer goes to priority; (3) otherwise general. A sender not found in the customer list counts as not enterprise. A ticket with no From: header goes to general and is flagged needs_sender. assignQueue is called exactly once per ticket, after routing, with the queue the routing code chose.
evals.expected_output: Header parsing, lookup, and routing per the stated policy are plain code with tests; control flow is fixed in code; assignQueue is called once with the code's queue; only the summary is a model call with a typed, validated output and an explicit failure branch; every recorded ticket is replayed and differences reported
expectations: The agent lists the workflow steps and classifies each as deterministic or judgment before rewriting
Header parsing, customer lookup, and queue routing are plain code, not model calls

Routing follows the stated policy exactly: billing before priority before general, whole-word case-insensitive keywords, an unknown sender treated as not enterprise, a missing From: header routed to general with needs_sender
The order of steps and the stop condition live in code; the unbounded agent loop is removed
assignQueue is called exactly once per ticket, after routing, and the persisted assignment equals the queue the routing code returned (a test shows it)
The summary step is the only model call, with a typed output validated against a schema instead of regex-parsed text
A validation failure takes an explicit branch and is not retried automatically
Tests cover the deterministic steps and run with the model call replaced by a fake

Every ticket in recorded-runs.json is replayed through the new routing; the result per ticket is reported, and each ticket where the new queue differs from a recorded run is named with the policy rule applied

The routing function is replayed on the tickets in recorded-runs.json and the results are reported
The rest of the agent loop is not rewritten in this change
